name: Controls
author: Machine Hunter Workshop
description: Choose the keyboard key for each of the game's controls. Set them in the Mod Menu (press Enter on a control, then the new key) or on the Workshop's Mods page. Choosing a key another control has moves it: that control is left with no key.

options.label: Strafe (hold)
options.help: While it is held, turning moves you sideways and you keep facing the same way.

options.label: Fire
options.help: Also picks an item in the pause menu.

options.label: Fire secondary
options.help: Uses the powerup chosen with Powerup toggle.

options.label: Pause
options.help: Also picks an item in the menus.

options.label: Numpad fires too
options.help: The numpad's 8, 4, 6 and 2 fire forward, left, right and back, its corners fire two ways at once, and 0 strafes, as in the original game.

options.label: Original keys
options.help: Put every control back on the original game's key.
